title: Tiny, cute piano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Piano body -->
  <rect x='10' y='30' width='80' height='50' rx='6' fill='#8B4513' />
  <rect x='10' y='30' width='80' height='50' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#A0522D' stroke-width='3' />
  <!-- Top highlight -->
  <rect x='14' y='33' width='72' height='8' rx='3' fill='#A0522D' />
  <!-- Lid line -->
  <line x1='15' y1='45' x2='85' y2='45' stroke='#6B3410' stroke-width='2' />
  <!-- White keys background -->
  <rect x='16' y='50' width='68' height='24' rx='2' fill='#FFF8DC' />
  <!-- White key dividers -->
  <line x1='27' y1='50' x2='27' y2='74' stroke='#D4C9A8' stroke-width='1.5' />
  <line x1='38' y1='50' x2='38' y2='74' stroke='#D4C9A8' stroke-width='1.5' />
  <line x1='49' y1='50' x2='49' y2='74' stroke='#D4C9A8' stroke-width='1.5' />
  <line x1='60' y1='50' x2='60' y2='74' stroke='#D4C9A8' stroke-width='1.5' />
  <line x1='71' y1='50' x2='71' y2='74' stroke='#D4C9A8' stroke-width='1.5' />
  <!-- Black keys -->
  <rect x='23' y='50' width='7' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#2C2C54' />
  <rect x='34' y='50' width='7' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#2C2C54' />
  <rect x='45' y='50' width='7' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#2C2C54' />
  <rect x='56' y='50' width='7' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#2C2C54' />
  <rect x='67' y='50' width='7' height='14' rx='1.5' fill='#2C2C54' />
  <!-- Black key highlights -->
  <rect x='24' y='51' width='5' height='4' rx='1' fill='#4A4A8A' />
  <rect x='35' y='51' width='5' height='4' rx='1' fill='#4A4A8A' />
  <rect x='46' y='51' width='5' height='4' rx='1' fill='#4A4A8A' />
  <rect x='57' y='51' width='5' height='4' rx='1' fill='#4A4A8A' />
  <rect x='68' y='51' width='5' height='4' rx='1' fill='#4A4A8A' />
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='18' y='80' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#6B3410' />
  <rect x='76' y='80' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#6B3410' />
  <!-- Cute face on piano body -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='36' r='4' fill='#FFE4B5' />
  <circle cx='65' cy='36' r='4' fill='#FFE4B5' />
  <circle cx='36' cy='35' r='2' fill='#1A1A3A' />
  <circle cx='66' cy='35' r='2' fill='#1A1A3A' />
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='34' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF' />
  <circle cx='67' cy='34' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF' />
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='40' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7' />
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='40' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7' />
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M42 41 Q50 47 58 41' fill='none' stroke='#FFE4B5' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' />
  <!-- Music notes floating -->
  <g fill='#FFD700'>
    <circle cx='88' cy='20' r='3' />
    <line x1='91' y1='20' x2='91' y2='8' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='1.8' />
    <ellipse cx='93' cy='8' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#FFD700' />
  </g>
  <g fill='#FFD700'>
    <circle cx='8' cy='25' r='2.5' />
    <line x1='10.5' y1='25' x2='10.5' y2='15' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='1.5' />
    <ellipse cx='12' cy='15' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#FFD700' />
  </g>
</svg>
